description: This file contains an XML template with embedded Jinja2 macros for generating Italian e-invoice XML documents. It defines formatting macros, address rendering, discount/margin rendering, and the main structure for creating an electronic invoice, including header, body, and item details.

methods.name: format_float
methods.description: Formats a floating point number with specified precision, defaulting to 2 decimal places, and handles absolute value.

methods.name: render_address
methods.description: Renders an address block as XML, including address lines, postal code, city, province (if available), and country.

methods.name: render_discount_or_margin
methods.description: Renders discount or margin information as XML, based on item discount percentages and margin type.
